gullibly: He gullibly believed every word of the stranger's story about buried treasure.
他轻信了那个陌生人关于埋藏宝藏的故事的每一个字。
credential: You need to show your credential before you can enter the building.
你需要出示证书才能进入这座大楼。
plagiarise: The student was punished because he chose to plagiarise part of his essay.
这名学生受到了惩罚，因为他抄袭了论文的一部分。
victimise: No one should victimise a person just because of his or her background.
任何人都不应该因为背景而迫害他人。
managerial: She gained valuable managerial experience while working at the small company.
她在这家小公司工作期间获得了宝贵的管理经验。
glacial: A glacial wind blew across the valley, making everyone shiver.
一阵冰冷的风吹过山谷，让每个人都瑟瑟发抖。
fauna: The island is famous for its rare fauna found nowhere else in the world.
这座岛以其世界上其他地方都没有的珍稀动物群而闻名。
regent: The young prince could not rule alone, so a regent governed the kingdom.
小王子无法独自统治，因此由一位摄政者管理王国。
interplay: The success of the project depended on the interplay between technology and art.
这个项目的成功取决于技术与艺术之间的相互作用。
corporeal: He seemed more interested in money than in any corporeal pleasure.
比起任何肉体上的享受，他似乎对金钱更感兴趣。
cardiac: Regular exercise can greatly reduce the risk of cardiac disease.
定期锻炼可以大大降低患心脏病的风险。
syntactic: The teacher explained that the sentence contained several syntactic errors.
老师解释说这个句子包含几处句法错误。
tinker: He likes to tinker with old clocks in his free time.
他空闲时喜欢摆弄旧时钟。
flagellum: Under the microscope, we could see the tiny flagellum of the moving cell.
在显微镜下，我们可以看到运动中的细胞的微小鞭毛。
odorous: An odorous smell rose from the kitchen when the fish was burnt.
鱼烧焦时，厨房里升起一股难闻的气味。
hypertext: Clicking on the hypertext took her to another page of the website.
点击超文本后，她进入了网站的另一个页面。
newsprint: The old magazines were printed on cheap paper made of newsprint.
这些旧杂志是用廉价的新闻纸印刷的。
harmonic: The singer's voice was so pure that every harmonic could be heard clearly.
这位歌手的嗓音如此纯净，每一个泛音都能听得清清楚楚。
oceanographer: The oceanographer spent months studying the temperature of the deep sea.
这位海洋学家花了几个月研究深海的温度。
speckle: Sunlight filtered through the leaves to speckle the floor with light.
阳光透过树叶洒下，在地板上点缀出光斑。
clamor: We could hear the clamor of excited children outside the school gate.
我们能听到学校门外兴奋的孩子们的喧闹声。
attire: The guests were asked to wear formal attire to the wedding.
客人们被要求穿着正式的服装参加婚礼。
untamed: The horse was still untamed and refused to let anyone ride it.
这匹马仍然未被驯服，拒绝让任何人骑它。
ordinal: First and second are examples of ordinal numbers.
第一和第二是序数词的例子。
telecommunication: Modern telecommunication makes it easy to talk to friends far away.
现代电信使人们可以轻松地与远方的朋友交谈。
fume: She fumed silently when her brother borrowed her bike without asking.
弟弟未经允许借走她的自行车时，她暗自生气。
salamander: The children found a small salamander hiding under a damp rock.
孩子们在潮湿的石头下发现了一只躲藏的小火蜥蜴。
cranial: The doctor examined the patient's cranial injuries after the accident.
事故发生后，医生检查了病人颅骨的伤势。
anomie: Sociologists study how anomie appears when a society changes too quickly.
社会学家研究当一个社会变化太快时，失范是如何出现的。
falcon: A falcon dived from the sky and caught the small bird.
一只猎鹰从空中俯冲下来，抓住了那只小鸟。
psychoanalysis: He spent several years in psychoanalysis to understand his childhood fears.
他花了几年时间接受精神分析来理解童年时的恐惧。
bilingualism: Bilingualism helps children communicate with people from different cultures.
双语能力帮助孩子与来自不同文化的人交流。
adversary: After the match, the two players shook hands and respected their adversary.
比赛结束后，两名选手握手，尊重他们的对手。
infest: The old house was infested with mice, so nobody wanted to live there.
那座老房子里老鼠成群，所以没人愿意住在那里。
encrust: Salt from the sea began to encrust the rocks near the shore.
海水中的盐分开始在海边的岩石上结成硬壳。
audible: Her voice was barely audible over the noise of the traffic.
在车辆的嘈杂声中，她的声音几乎听不见。
nimble: The nimble cat jumped onto the high wall in a single leap.
敏捷的猫一跃跳上了高墙。
certitude: She answered the question with complete certitude and no doubt at all.
她回答那个问题时充满信心，毫无怀疑。
sequoia: The giant sequoia has stood in the forest for hundreds of years.
这棵巨大的红杉已经在森林里矗立了数百年。
tributary: This small river is a tributary of the great river to the south.
这条小河是南面那条大河的一条支流。
